title: Thai Larb Kicked Up
description: A spicy Thai-inspired dish kicked up with southern flair, featuring mozzarella and larb in a keto-friendly recipe.
instructions: Heat coconut oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add sliced chilies and cook until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add ground beef and cook until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Add larb spice mix and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add fish sauce and stir to combine.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until the flavors have melded together.
Stir in chopped cilantro and cook for an additional minute.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Transfer the mixture to a serving dish and top with mozzarella cheese.
Serve hot and garnish with fresh basil.
Serve with additional chilies on the side, if desired.
